anomalies.observed: U4 pin 28 (VCC, type power_in) sits on the isolated net 'Net-(U4-VCC)', whose only other member is C7 pin 1. It is NOT a member of the 'VCC' rail net, even though U4's other supply pins are: pin 9 (VDD), pin 6 (VBAT) and pin 11 (BS1) are all on 'VCC'. The only thing C7 (2.2 µF) decouples is this floating node, since C7 pin 2 is on GND.
anomalies.expected: A VCC supply pin must be tied to the supply rail it references. U4's VCC pin (28) should be on the board 'VCC' net (as its VDD pin 9 already is), with C7 (2.2 µF) acting as decoupling between that rail and GND.

evidence.quote: C7 (2.2 µF) — U4 VCC (digital-logic supply pin) to GND

anomalies.impact: The SSD1306 display driver's VCC supply pin has no DC path to the VCC rail (it is only capacitively coupled to GND through C7), so its VCC supply is left floating and the OLED display will not operate.

parsed.summary: The board otherwise matches the specification, but the SSD1306's VCC supply pin (U4.28) is isolated on its own net with only decoupling cap C7 and is missing from the board VCC rail that powers U4's VDD/VBAT pins, which would leave the display's supply floating and non-functional.
